form.label: Network
form.description: The Palo Alto and the VyOS router. Needs both sending syslog to Splunk.

panel.title: Alert: Firewall or router config changed

html.p: Severity 5. A config change was committed on the Palo Alto or the VyOS router. Playbook steps (page 17)

search.query: `paloalto_config` OR (`paloalto_system` "commit") OR (`vyos` ("Successful change to active configuration" OR "commit")) | table _time host sourcetype admin cmd configuration_path result _raw

html.p: Severity 4. The Palo Alto matched a high or critical threat signature. Playbook steps (page 17)

search.query: `paloalto_threat` severity IN ("critical","high") | table _time src_ip dest_ip dest_port app threat_name severity action
`paloalto_traffic` action IN ("blocked","deny","drop","reset-both","reset-client","reset-server") | stats count by dest_port dest_ip | sort - count | head 20

html.p: An internal server talking to the same outside IP over and over is a beacon.

search.query: `paloalto_traffic` action="allowed" | stats count dc(dest_port) as ports latest(app) as app by src_ip dest_ip | where count>=20 | sort - count | head 30
`paloalto_system` ("logged in" OR "auth-success" OR "auth-fail" OR "failed authentication") | table _time host description _raw
`vyos` ("Accepted" OR "Failed password" OR "session opened") | table _time host _raw
